## Public API

| Export | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `initPersistence()` | Open DuckDB, create schema + indexes + migrations |
| `SCHEMA_VERSION` / `getSchemaVersion()` | Migration epoch |
| `savePlayerNow` / `scheduleSavePlayer` | Upsert player row |
| `saveFloorNow` / `scheduleSaveFloor` / `loadFloorByDepth` | Shared floor durability |
| `saveWorldMeta` | World seed / turn counter |
| `appendChatMessages` / `loadRecentChat` | Durable chat_log |
| `loadPlayerByName` | Lookup by display name (indexed `name_lower`) |
| `loadResumablePlayerByName` / `isResumablePlayer` | Disconnected `playing`/`inventory` only |
| `loadWorld` / `hydrateFromDatabase` (via `world.ts`) | Boot recovery |
| `flushPersistence` / `closePersistence` | Shutdown drain + test teardown |

## Schema

- `world_meta`, `players`, `floors`, `chat_log`, `schema_migrations`
- Indexes: `name_lower`, `connected`, `floor_depth`, `game_phase`, `last_active`, composite resume, `floors.updated_at`, `chat_log.posted_at`

## Invariants (do not break)

1. **Single connection, serialized queue** — all reads/writes go through `enqueueDb()`.
2. **Player upsert** — `INSERT … ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE`; never delete-then-insert races.
3. **Bind param names** — use `$lookup`, not `$name_lower` (column name collision).
4. **JSON columns** — stored as `VARCHAR`; deserialize via `parseJsonColumn()`.
5. **Row isolation** — `queryRows()` deep-clones each row (`JSON.parse(JSON.stringify)`).
6. **Debounced saves** — respect `closing` flag; `closePersistence()` force-drains pending maps.
7. **Await pattern in tests** — `(await loadPlayerByName("x"))?.id`, not `await loadPlayerByName("x")?.id`.
8. **Shared floors** — multi-player mutations on a depth must `saveFloorNow` / disconnect-save so cold start does not re-generate.

## Resume + reconnect contract

| Event | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| WS disconnect | Soft grace (~45s, `GROKHACK_DISCONNECT_GRACE_MS`): durable `savePlayerNow` + `saveFloorNow` immediately; player stays on map; **"has disconnected" chat + map removal only after grace** |
| Rejoin same name (within grace) | Silent resume — same player id, floor, inventory, explored; no chat spam |
| Rejoin same name (after grace / cold) | Resume if `playing` or `inventory`; personal "Welcome back" only |
| Stale socket close after reconnect | No-op (`playerConnIds` guards) |
| Name online (live socket) | **Last socket wins** — supersedes stale conn; never `"Name already in use"` for playing/inventory |
| session_disconnect.reason | `client` \| `server` \| `timeout` \| `restart` \| `grace_expired` (no schema change) |
| Dead / won | Fresh run; stale row deleted |
| Server restart | `hydrateFromDatabase()` restores players + floors + chat |
| SIGINT/SIGTERM | `world.flushAllDurable()` → `flushPersistence` → `closePersistence` (session-ha) |

**Full HA contract:** `data/fleet/SESSION_HA.md`

**Restored on reconnect:** `floorDepth`, explored map, full `state` (HP, gold, turns, hunger, XP, gear, inventory), shared floor items/monsters, recent chat_log.
**Not restored:** dead/won runs; duplicate connected name.

**Client (`public/play.js`):** first reconnect attempt **250ms**, then exponential backoff (cap 30s); rejoin with same `playerName` + sticky `sessionId` from sessionStorage; silent resume unlocks input + refocuses canvas.

```bash
npx vitest run server/session-ha.test.ts server/resume.contract.test.ts server/persistence.test.ts server/world.test.ts
node scripts/prove-reconnect.mjs   # optional live WS proof
```

## Integration points

- `server/index.ts` — `initPersistence()` → `hydrateFromDatabase()`; SIGINT/SIGTERM → `flushAllDurable`
- `server/world.ts` — save on disconnect/join/turn/descend; chat → `appendChatMessages`; `loadResumablePlayerByName` on join
- `public/play.js` — sticky `sessionId` + reconnect-by-name (session-ha / play-ux)
